response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.product_color, 'NO_COLOR') AS color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS total FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'NO_COLOR')), s AS (SELECT color, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(total) FROM c) AS avg_total FROM c) SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(total - avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s WHERE total > avg_total
